package.name: gcs_comms
package.description: GCS communication bridge (gcs_mavlink_node): raw-MAVLink link to the ground control station over Channel B (ICD §4.1/§4.2), GCS command decode, and link-status heartbeat monitoring (GCS-001). Mission upload state machine and MC_STATUS/MC_DETECTION/MC_HEALTH telemetry multiplexer (GCS-002/GCS-003) land separately. SDD-MC-001 §11. SRS refs: FR-060-064, IR-010-014.
